characters.description: One record per character, always nine. The first five are Cloud, Barret, Tifa, Aerith and Red XIII; the order of the other four is not mapped yet. party holds indices into this list.

game_pause.description: EndGameState.GamePause: non-zero while the game is paused (the system menu, including mid-battle).

game_state.description: EndGameState.GameState, the EGameState enum: 0 NONE, 1 BOOT, 4 TITLE, 5 INIT_PERSISTENT, 6 GAME_IDLE, 7 PAUSE_IDLE, 8 MENU_IDLE, 9 UNINIT_PERSISTENT, 10 PAUSE_IDLE_STARTCHAPTER. Seen in practice: 6 at the title screen and in play, 8 with the system menu open, battle included.

gil.description: Gil. null if no gil entry is among the first 64 inventory slots.

party.description: The active party, leader first: three indices into characters, 16 for an empty slot.

party_gauges.description: The battle HUD gauges of the three active-party slots, in party order. atb runs from 0 to atb_max (3000), two segments of 1500 each; limit runs from 0 to 1. Outside battle they hold whatever the HUD last showed.

play_time_s.description: Play time in seconds, as the save and the main menu show it (they print it as hours:minutes:seconds).

target_hp_pct.description: HP of the locked-on enemy, 0 to 100, as the HUD bar shows it (the game shows no number). null when no enemy bar is on screen.

target_stagger_pct.description: Stagger gauge of the locked-on enemy, 0 to 100. null when no enemy bar is on screen.
